title: The Debt-Form Dream Registry

features.name: the property remembers what it owes
features.desc-on-touch: Photographs of land that dreams itself differently when it knows its debt. The image shifts: same place, two angles, both true.

features.name: the building that carries its price
features.desc-on-touch: A clinic, a hospital ward, a surgery built on unpaid labour. The photograph shows both: the structure and the cost it is configured around.

features.name: the registry itself
features.desc-on-touch: A catalogue of places that have learned to photograph their own debts. Each image is a bill that never arrived but the land keeps paying.

inscription: debts learn to carry images; places photograph themselves paying, forever

file.name: Unpaid_Medical_Interventions_Registry.jpg
file.note: Photographs of country medical sites—surgeries performed without compensation, clinics built on volunteer labour, procedures that left no written record but changed the places they happened in.
